crossRefs.note: You shall sow the eighth year, and eat of the fruits from the old store until the ninth year. Until its fruits come in…
They ate unleavened cakes and parched grain of the produce of the land on the next day after the Passover, in the same…
“This will be the sign to you: This year, you will eat that which grows of itself, and in the second year that which…
He reasoned within himself, saying, ‘What will I do, because I don’t have room to store my crops?’

translations.web: You shall eat old supplies long kept, and you shall move out the old because of the new.
translations.bsb: You will still be eating the old supply of grain when you need to clear it out to make room for the new.
translations.kjv: And ye shall eat old store, and bring forth the old because of the new.
translations.asv: And ye shall eat old store long kept, and ye shall bring forth the old because of the new.
